test_result.scope: Actual compiler text execution and explicit local protocol/renderer test doubles; zero live vision/API calls.

source_findings: Provider executes only as an explicitly configured trusted absolute local executable, with stripped inherited environment, strict JSON, bounded pipe I/O, process-group cleanup and persisted retry/time accounting.
Request binds actual PNG bytes, current artifact hashes, full camera/spec/frame/seed settings and frozen source identity.
Returned review is schema-validated and constrained to three numeric changes and six priority-ordered camera-specific issues.
Unconfigured provider returns pending without calls or automatic acceptance.
limits: This is a trusted local stdio protocol, not an implemented remote API client or a configured vision model.
The zero-cost declaration is not an operating-system network/billing sandbox. Trust/authorization of the executable remains external.

Optional explicit local PNG/JPEG reference payloads now attach bytes, labels, provenance URLs and hashes. Responses must echo all reference identities; no reference match or live provider execution is inferred.
Live provider end-to-end actual visual review/regeneration remains unverified.

compiler_bug.observation: A compiled small-radius/thick-wall example passed generic schema yet .86*radius-wall produced an inner base radius -0.004.
compiler_bug.acceptance_check: Renderer-specific supported-profile constraints reject negative radii and regressions cover them; no render was started for the invalid example.
compiler_bug.resolution: Current compiler-side supported-profile guard rejects negative radii, rolled-lip/base inconsistencies, off-center stream overflow, fixed-card collisions and other fixed-builder offset conflicts. Adapter also validates initial/patched specs with this guard. Direct Japanese/English and rejection probes are saved.
